steps.caption: Open an outreach draft — here, the email to Ananya Rao.
Open Ask AI. It knows you're viewing this outreach draft.
Ask it to send the proposal email.
It doesn't send. It shows an approval card: 'Nothing has been sent or changed'.
'Waiting for you' — the request is paused until you decide.
The table shows exactly what would change: recipient, subject and the full text.
Approve binds to this exact text and recipient — then it opens your mail app; you press send yourself.
Rejected — nothing was changed, nothing was sent.
